domain_number.description: PTP domain number (0–65535). All devices in the same time domain must match.

transport_mode.description: Transport mode. Use 'udp' for most deployments; 'ieee_1588' for legacy L2-only setups.

clock_identity_source.description: How clock identity is generated: 'hw' (MAC-based, recommended) or 'sw' (random).

slave_only.description: If true, this device behaves only as a slave (ordinary clock). Set false for boundary clocks.

allow_multiple_sources.description: Allow multiple timing sources. Useful for redundancy or grandmaster failover.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity (0=fatal, 7=debug). Set to 2 or 3 for production; 4+ for debugging.

log_sync_messages.description: Log every SYNC message for deep diagnostics (can be very verbose).

announce_interval.description: Interval between Announce messages (seconds). Typical: 1 or 2.

sync_interval.description: Interval between Sync messages (seconds). Use -1 for 'as fast as hardware allows'.

delay_req_interval.description: Minimum interval between Delay_Req messages (seconds). Set to 1 or 2.

primary_domain.description: Fallback domain number when domain mismatch occurs.

hw_timestamping.description: Enable hardware timestamping for sub-microsecond precision (recommended).

ptp_device.description: Explicit PTP device (e.g., '/dev/ptp0'). Leave empty to auto-detect.

interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to configure for PTP. At least one is required.

enabled.description: Enable or disable this interface. Disabled interfaces are commented out in config.

hw_timestamping.description: Override global hardware timestamping for this interface (if needed).

priority1.description: Priority1 for best master clock election (0–254). Lower = higher preference.

priority2.description: Priority2 (typically same as priority1). Lower = higher preference.

clock_class.description: Clock class (0–255). 6 = boundary clock, 13 = ordinary slave clock.

clock_identity.description: Explicit 8-byte clock identity (hex string or MAC). Leave blank to auto-generate.

clock_offset.description: Fixed offset (nanoseconds) to apply to this interface's clock.

master_only.description: If true, this interface never becomes a slave (use only for boundary clocks).

announce_interval.description: Per-interface override of announce interval (seconds), or null to use global.

sync_interval.description: Per-interface override of sync interval (seconds), or null to use global.

delay_req_interval.description: Per-interface override of delay request interval (seconds), or null to use global.

dscp.description: DSCP value (0–63) for PTP traffic QoS marking on this interface.

redundant_interfaces.description: List of interface names to group as redundant (for redundant domain support).

unicast_addresses.description: List of unicast master addresses (IPs) to negotiate with (instead of multicast).

delay_asymmetry.description: One-way path asymmetry (nanoseconds). Used only with peer-to-peer delay mechanism.

initial_frequency.description: Initial frequency correction (parts-per-billion) applied at startup.
